ctlNoManual: This connection has no manually triggered process

ctlQueueTip: Sends queued status changes to the external system right now — without waiting for the automatic run.
ctlRetryTip: Queues the failed rows for another attempt.
ctlPingTip: Sends a test request to the external system's address.

stlAdvanceAppliesNext: applied to the next debts automatically
